caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher with a rounded body and a narrow neck that flares outward at the lip, forming a spout. The pitcher has a single, ear-shaped handle attached to the upper portion of one side. The primary color of the pitcher is a warm, light brown with visible texture and shading that gives it a three-dimensional appearance. There is a decorative blue design on the front of the pitcher, consisting of a stylized pattern with curved lines and a clustered motif near the base of the design. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and there are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
